name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Move between fixed-size pages of a list, table, or feed. Two layouts — numeric (Prev / 1 / 2 / 3 / Next, with ellipsis-collapse past 7 pages) and cursor (Prev / Page N of M / Next). The numeric layout maps to keyboard / desktop-density operator tables; the cursor layout maps to mobile and infinite-feed-but-with-page-anchors.
